premise: As the sun goes down the valley gets ready for bed: the light goes gold, the moon comes up over the sleepy old mountain, fireflies dance over the lagoon, and everyone says goodnight in turn.
inspiration: The goodnight round of nursery rhyme, set in a prehistoric valley, the old mountain sleepiest of all.
lesson: Saying goodnight to the world makes it feel safe.

en-US.title: Goodnight, Valley
en-US.text: {canvas:sunset 0.8} {sfx:crickets} [softly] The sun was going down over the valley. The big flat rock glowed gold. {all:tint #FFC9D6 0.3 2s} The lagoon turned pink. {all:face happy} {all:glow 0.3 #FFC48A} Everyone had played all day long, and now it was time for bed. {all:wobble} [yawns] One big yawn… then another… {canvas:night 0.8} And up came the moon, over the sleepy old mountain far away. {canvas:fireflies 0.5} Then, one by one, out came the fireflies, little lights dancing low over the water. {all:face surprised} [in awe] "Ooh," said everyone. "Goodnight, little lights." {all:face happy} [whispers] Goodnight, lagoon. {all:pulse 0.3} Goodnight, giant lily pads. Goodnight, big flat rock, still warm from the sun. {all:pulse 0.2} Goodnight, tree fern. {all:hearts 0.4} Goodnight, monkey-puzzle tree. {all:face sleeping} Goodnight, red cliffs, far away. And goodnight, sleepy old mountain… [softly] but the mountain was asleep already. {all:pulse 0.2} It always is.

es-ES.title: Buenas noches, valle
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunset 0.8} {sfx:crickets} [softly] El sol se escondía sobre el valle. La gran roca plana brillaba, dorada. {all:tint #FFC9D6 0.3 2s} La laguna se volvió rosa. {all:face happy} {all:glow 0.3 #FFC48A} Todos habían jugado el día entero, y ya era hora de dormir. {all:wobble} [yawns] Un bostezo grande… y luego otro… {canvas:night 0.8} Y salió la luna, por encima de la vieja montaña dormida, allá lejos. {canvas:fireflies 0.5} Entonces, una a una, salieron las luciérnagas, lucecitas que bailaban bajito sobre el agua. {all:face surprised} [in awe] —Oooh —dijeron todos—. Buenas noches, lucecitas. {all:face happy} [whispers] Buenas noches, laguna. {all:pulse 0.3} Buenas noches, nenúfares gigantes. Buenas noches, gran roca plana, todavía calentita del sol. {all:pulse 0.2} Buenas noches, helecho gigante. {all:hearts 0.4} Buenas noches, araucaria. {all:face sleeping} Buenas noches, riscos rojos, allá lejos. Y buenas noches, vieja montaña dormida… [softly] pero la montaña ya estaba dormida. {all:pulse 0.2} Siempre lo está.
